recentItems.title: Hey Choodu Choodu Lyrical | Tatvam | Dinesh Tej, Dhasvika Kinthalli | Chaitan Bharadwaj | Arjun Kola
recentItems.description:
Immerse Yourself In The Enchanting Melody - Hey Choodu Choodu Video Song!

Lahari Music presents the official Lyrical Song of Hey Choodu Choodu from the Telugu film Tatvam!

Composed by Chaitan Bharadwaj with expressive lyrics penned by Bhaskarabhatla, this soulful track is beautifully rendered by Hymath Mohammed, starring Dinesh Tej and Dhasvika Kinthalli.

Directed by Arjun Kola, Tatvam brings a captivating cinematic story to life. 

Subscribe to our YouTube Channel : http://bit.ly/1hE4KpS​
